At j≤k, the coefficient (N−k)/(N−j) interpolates from the opposite endpoint N to the median k. For j≥k the analogous coefficient is k/j using endpoint 0. All denominators are positive for N≥2. Both coefficients are at least k/N with k=floor(N/2). The central convex fiber contains zero, so rescaling up to N/k contains every fiber. Independently checked the coefficients and constants with rational arithmetic for N=2,…,50.

The exact hull hypothesis makes the full continuous shadow the convex hull of the sheared integer fibers. The dilation contains it even if the middle fiber has zero d-volume. The uniform volume coefficient follows from N/k≤3 and N/k=2 for even N. On an inherited rank-one lattice, taking a primitive affine integer coordinate changes only the base, so the same volume calculation applies.
